scope: Actual CMSIS semaphoreNew/queue creation/send/delete/native heap/scheduler/critical/movement graph; binary/counting/static/dynamic lifetimes, full/overwrite/front/back/overlap paths and heap reclamation
limitations: Controlled prekernel, nonblocking operations have no waiters. Caller BL targets are authenticated and only allocated-header caller LR is normalized. Full blocking task scheduling, mutex ownership, physical concurrency and whole-image byte equality remain gates.
